## Required Background
{
  "deck_context": {
    "source_summary": "Class 16 begins Week 4 of a traditional AEM Sites course for frontend-oriented developers. It builds the minimum Java runtime vocabulary needed before Sling Models: core module, OSGi bundle, Declarative Services component, service contract, runtime states and Sling Resource API.",
    "core_claim": "Compiled Java becomes an AEM capability only after bundle packaging and resolution, Declarative Services lifecycle requirements and a correct content boundary; diagnose each handoff with observable runtime evidence.",
    "canonical_facts": [
      "The Maven core module produces the project's OSGi bundle JAR.",
      "A bundle manifest declares symbolic identity, version, imported packages and exported packages.",
      "Successful Java compilation does not prove that Apache Felix can resolve runtime package imports.",
      "A bundle, a Declarative Services component and a registered service are different runtime objects.",
      "A plain Java class inside a bundle is not automatically an OSGi component or service.",
      "@Component declares a Declarative Services component and @Reference expresses a service dependency.",
      "Required references and required configuration must be satisfied before a component can activate.",
      "A bundle can be Active while a contained component remains unsatisfied.",
      "The local AEM SDK exposes the Web Console; cloud environments expose read-only runtime evidence through Developer Console.",
      "A Resource exposes a path, name, resource type, properties and children without requiring direct JCR Node use.",
      "ValueMap supports typed property access and adaptTo bridges a Resource to supported higher-level abstractions.",
      "Prefer AEM product APIs, then Sling abstractions; use JCR only for JCR-specific needs and OSGi for container concerns.",
      "Administrative repository access is not allowed; background access uses a scoped service user and a correctly closed ResourceResolver.",
      "AEM as a Cloud Service treats deployed code and configuration as immutable at runtime."
    ],
    "canonical_terms": [
      "core",
      "OSGi bundle",
      "Apache Felix",
      "MANIFEST.MF",
      "Bundle-SymbolicName",
      "Import-Package",
      "Export-Package",
      "Declarative Services",
      "@Component",
      "@Reference",
      "service registry",
      "Installed",
      "Resolved",
      "Active",
      "unsatisfied",
      "Resource",
      "ValueMap",
      "ResourceResolver",
      "adaptTo"
    ]
  },
  "slide_local_context": {
    "required_background": "Create an opening overview with a compact path from Java source in the core module to an OSGi bundle, a managed runtime component and an AEM content resource."
  }
}
